sections.section_name: Section A (Economics, Financial Markets & Financial Institutions)
topics: Unit 1: Basic Economics - Scarcity and Choice, Allocation of Resources; Demand and Supply; Cost-Benefit Analysis & Opportunity Cost; Market Structure; Growth and Development; Nepalese Economy Status, Prospects & Challenges; Monetary & Fiscal Policy

Unit 2: Financial Market - Role & functions of financial market; Capital Market of Nepal; Money Market; Repo & Reverse Repo; Open Market Operations; Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR); Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR); Over-the-Counter (OTC) Market

Unit 3: Financial Institutions in Nepal: Role, Contribution, and Status - Banking Institutions (Commercial, Development, Finance, Microfinance, Infrastructure Development Bank); Non-bank Financial Institutions (Insurance Companies, Employees Provident Fund - EPF, Citizen Investment Trust/Fund - CIT, Social Security Fund - SSF)

sections.section_name: Section B (Digital Banking, Terminology & General Knowledge)
topics: Unit 4: Digital / Electronic Payment Systems - Electronic Cheque Clearing (ECC); IPS, ConnectIPS, RTGS, SWIFT; Internet & Mobile Banking, QR, NFC; Payment Cards; Digital Wallets; Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC)

Unit 5: Key Basic Banking Terminology - Capital Fund; Loan Loss Provision; Credit-Deposit (CD) Ratio; Letter of Credit, Bank Guarantee; Refinancing, Rescheduling, Restructuring; Base Rate; Credit Information and Blacklisting; Credit Ratings; KYC; Audit and Internal Control

Unit 6: General Knowledge - Global Countries, Locations, Currencies; Top Economies; Major Trade/Sea Routes; Major Tradeable Items; Of and About Nepal: History, Geography, Demography, Agriculture, Industry, Imports/Exports & Values, Tourist Destinations

sections.section_name: Section A (Banking Laws, Other Regulations & Organizational Behavior)
topics: Unit 1: Banking Related Laws - Nepal Rastra Bank Act 2058; Bank and Financial Institution Act (BAFIA) 2073; Payment and Settlement Act 2075; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2064; Banking Offence & Punishment Act 2064; Negotiable Instruments Act 2034; Electronic Transaction Act 2063; NRB Government Transaction Directive 2076

Unit 2: Other Related Laws - Companies Act 2063; Labour Act 2074; Public Procurement Act 2063; Right to Information Act 2064; Rastriya Banijya Bank Employee Service Regulation 2070; NRB Unified Directives & Circulars

Unit 3: Organizational Behavior - Job Description, ToR & Responsibilities; Motivation & Performance; Communication Skills & Approaches; Team Building & Workmanship; Customer Satisfaction; Grievance Handling

sections.section_name: Section B (Organizational Role, Office Supports & Mathematics)
topics: Unit 4: Organizational Role - Customer Service Division (CSD); Customer Satisfaction & Service Delivery; Reception Desk; Secretariat Desk; Document Verification; Account Opening & Statements; Correspondences (Darta/Chalani); Record Keeping, Filing & Digitization
Unit 5: Office Supports - Office Layout & Logistics; Event Organizing; Time Keeping; Communication Skills; Grievance Handling; Safety & Security Standards; Clean & Healthy Office Environment
Unit 6: Basic Mathematics - Interest Calculation; Discount & Commission; Percentage & Ratios; Unitary Method; Profit & Loss; Sampling & Probabilities; Simple & Weighted Averages

sections.section_name: Section A (Cash Handling, Customer Service & Banking Laws)
topics: Unit 1: Daily Cash Handling - Opening/Closing cash transactions; Security measures; Precautions on receipts/payments; Currency note security features; Counting, tagging, bundling; Toda Chalan (Cash Transport/Remittance Management); Clean Note Policy; Soiled Note management; Cash handling
Unit 2: Customer Service - Customer Satisfaction & Service; Signature & ID Verification; Front Desk role; Payment processing; Grievance handling; Currency exchange; Financial Literacy

Unit 3: Banking Related Laws and Directives - Nepal Rastra Bank Act 2058; Bank and Financial Institution Act (BAFIA) 2073; Payment and Settlement Act 2075; Money Laundering Prevention Act 2064; Banking Offence & Punishment Act 2064; Negotiable Instruments Act 2034; Electronic Transaction Act 2063; NRB Government Transaction Directive 2076

sections.section_name: Section B (Gold/Silver Loans, Vault Accounting & Other Laws)
topics: Unit 4: Gold/Silver Loan Transactions - Jewellery/Bullion/Bars/Coins identification; Purity testing & Assaying; Spot Price & Appraised Value; Loan-to-Value (LTV) Ratio; Margin Calls; Loan Guarantee Commission; Insurance coverage

Unit 5: Accounting and Vault Management - Vault keys & safety, handover/takeover, security; Vault opening/closing procedures; CCTV/monitoring; Fire/disaster protection; Cash journals, ledgers, control ledgers; Day-end reporting; Vault registers; Note-chest / Note Kosh transactions

Unit 6: Other Related Laws, Policies - Companies Act 2063; Labour Act 2074; Public Procurement Act 2063; Right to Information Act 2064; Rastriya Banijya Bank Employee Service Regulation 2070; NRB Unified Directives & Circulars
Evaluation of candidate's knowledge, confidence, and suitability for the Senior Assistant (Admin/Cash) position.
